notes:
User is shopping for high-quality, durable sandals with sturdy straps and plans to compare Teva, Birkenstock, Sanuk, Merrell, and Keen. Suggested retailers include REI, DSW, Zappos, and Amazon.

User plans to organize and declutter their closet this weekend. Their old sneakers occupy a shoe rack and may be stored or discarded. They plan to group shoes by type, keep frequently worn pairs accessible, store out-of-season footwear separately, and use dividers, stackable racks, bins, hanging organizers, or over-the-door racks to maximize space.

Old sneakers were stored under the bed and developed an odor. User plans to have them polished and conditioned by a cobbler; because no location was provided, no specific shop was recommended. They agreed to use reviews and personal referrals. Before storage, clean and deodorize sneakers, ensure they are completely dry, maintain their shape with shoe trees or acid-free stuffing, use odor absorbers in humid conditions, keep them ventilated and away from heat/sunlight, and check periodically for mold or mildew. Protective bags/boxes may prevent dust and scratches, but storage should not worsen odors. Waterproofing may be considered if suitable for the material.

User plans to donate old dress shoes to a local charity thrift store this Saturday. They will call ahead and check donation guidelines. Shoes should be clean, polished, wearable, and free of personal items; heavily worn or damaged shoes may be rejected.

User wants a new jogging route after running the same route for months. Their location is unknown, so route-finding tools (Google Maps, local parks departments, Strava, MapMyRun, Runkeeper) and local recommendations were suggested. Prioritize safe, well-lit routes, visibility, hydration, awareness of traffic/obstacles, and telling someone the planned route and return time.
